# Contributing

Contributions are welcomed and [anyone](#roles) may contribute through posting comments, discussions, raising issues (problems or feature requests), and pull requests (direct change suggestions).

Some work is limited to the repository [Maintainers](#maintainers).

By contributing, participants agree to follow:
- [buildingSMART Code of Conduct](https://www.buildingsmart.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Behaviour-Code-of-Conduct-Policy-2023.pdf)
- [License agreements and Copyright Notice](../LICENSE.md)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.buildingsmart.org/terms-of-service/)
- [Intellectual Property Policy](https://app.box.com/s/rg081ahyq1euw8uw6efql6m2fcofm558)
- other relevant [policies](https://www.buildingsmart.org/about/policies/)

Once approved, submissions may become part of buildingSMART deliverables and publications.

## How to use GitHub 

If you are new to GitHub platform, you might want to see the [GitHub Introduction](./GitHub_intro.md) page first.

## Contributing guidelines

* Before opening a new issue or pull request, please check the existing ones, perhaps someone already raised it.
* Keep contributions focused on solving a single issue or bug.
* Link Pull Requests to Issues by mentioning it. If an issue doesn't exist - add it first.
* Be specific.
* Be kind and respectful.
* Explain the reason behind your feedback.
* Ask questions when something is unclear.
* Add examples, screenshots, or links when useful.
* Avoid sarcasm or vague criticism.
* Assume good intent.

## Roles

Anyone can read all content of the public repository, read the [Discussions](https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.x-development/discussions) and [Issues](https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.x-development/issues), and copy (fork) the materials (in line with [License agreements](../LICENSE.md).

### Contributors

Contributors are all who engage in the repository from commenting on issues to submitting proposed changes to the standard. Anyone can contribute, not only buildingSMART members, but not all contributions will be accepted. That is subject to buildingSMART processes, roadmaps and policies.

Contributors can:
* post and participate in [Issues](https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.x-development/issues) and comment on them 
* post and participate in [Discussions](https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.x-development/discussions)
* submit [Pull Requests](https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.x-development/pulls) (change proposals)
* review Issues and Pull Requests

GitHub differentiates contributors as all authors of commits that were approved and merged to the repository history. You can see that list here: https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.x-development/graphs/contributors?all=1

### Maintainers

The maintainers include bSI Management Office, relevant Working Group members and other assigned individuals. 

Repository maintainers are responsible for:

* Managing issues and pull requests - review, approve, merge etc.
* Ensuring consistency and quality
* Coordinating releases
* Building automation pipelines
* Managing roles and access rights
* Escalating significant decisions to the appropriate buildingSMART groups and committees
* And any other admin responsibilities

## Thank you

Thank you for contributing. Clear issues, thoughtful comments, and careful reviews help make this repository better for everyone.
